d:
Dipavli ke pavan parv par man lakshmi ki aaradhna aur kripa prapti ke lie sunen anuradha paudval ki madhur aur bhaktimay aavaz men shri lakshmi chalisa.
Man lakshmi ko dhan, vaibhav, sukh, samriddhi aur aishvary ki devi mana jata hai. dipavli ke shubh avsar par shraddha aur bhakti ke sath shri lakshmi chalisa ka path karen aur man lakshmi ka aashirvad prapt karen.
shri lakshmi chalisa
Singer: Anuradha Paudwal
Man lakshmi ki kripa se aapke ghar-parivar men sukh, shanti, dhan-dhany aur samriddhi bani rahe.
